svg.text: ASH Dotfiles version 5.0 OMEGA. Ultra-retina master application icon at 2048 by 2048 pixels. Features the Catppuccin Mocha color palette with 7 animated wave layers, 4 orbital rings, 12 particle emitters, and full constellation map. The definitive ASH brand mark.
